product_launches.description: ASRA launched STEER (Systemic Tool for Exploring and Evaluating Risks), a framework to help government policy teams assess and respond to systemic, cascading risks, featuring linked assessment and response pathways and a shared workspace. Over 250 early adopters have trialed the tool since a June 2025 demo.
